Eric Barker produced three very promising efforts in the Hammer, Discus and Shot events and one looks forward to seeing him in action regularly throughout the summer.

As usual Glyn Ratcliffe and Eric Barker scored well in the heavy-weight section although Glyn, now taking a keen interest in the technique of hammer throwing, found he could not stay in the circle with three turns and failed to register a throw.
